question: Within matched prior-SOXX-trend and first-trade-year weak/good exact-f696 126-session windows, which of eight economically preselected existing Stage1 inputs differ in level, and is any difference consistent enough to motivate a separate training-only information hypothesis?

method.authority: Use only the drift-card-pinned original39 Qlib Recorder feature frame and exact-f696 0bp Tiered daily/rolling126 account; verify exact source SHA/NAS and native Qlib day calendar
method.normalization: For each fixed input, subtract its 2011-2022 finite training median and divide by its finite training standard deviation, both computed before held history
method.window_statistic: Mean normalized value across each of all819 contiguous126-session windows, using the exact944 signal dates; preserve every weak/good label from the original SOXX paired log excess
method.matched_control: Prior signal-day SOXX 5/20-session return-sign state crossed with first-trade calendar year; retain all16 cells and compare only cells with weak and good windows, weighted by smaller group count
method.report: For all eight fixed inputs in their listed order report per-cell weak-minus-good mean, weighted descriptive contrast and number of positive/negative cells. Also report 2023 unmatched means separately. No input is selected or converted to a threshold from these outcomes.
method.coverage: 944 exact-f696 sessions, 16quarters,819 windows, 2023/2026 partial and 2024/2025 complete years
method.stop: Stop on source hash/NAS, Qlib calendar, feature order, 3020 training rows,944/819 coverage, component closure or any nonfinite required input.

scientific_boundary: These eight retrospective comparisons are descriptive development feedback, not an independent feature screen.
